scope: At most 24 briefs, derived only from proven gaps surfaced by Tasks A-D's actual findings plus this session's own independent verification -- not invented. Ranked by evidence strength (high -> low). Every brief is draft-not-reviewed/provisional; none carries mastery credit or automatic promotion. No hockey-content judgment calls were made -- briefs describe WHERE a gap is and WHAT evidence supports it, not the specific tactical answer key.

briefs.evidenceGapDescription: Zero genuine skating-movement questions exist for U15 in any of the 3 reachable live catalogs (experimental-bank, legacy-live-bank, scenario-engine-seed), confirmed by a full manual text sweep (skate/edge/pivot/crossover/stride/agility/footwork terms) beyond the narrower keyword list Task B's own coverage tool uses. src/data/curriculum-ledger.json's node u15.edges-balance and u15.agility-mobility are both locked at depth 'R' (refinement, at speed under random/opposed conditions) -- the curriculum design explicitly expects this content to exist at U15, not just I/D-level basics.
briefs.recommendedShape: One new U15 scene pairing an edge-control/agility cue with the bank's existing geometry-comparison question pattern (e.g. two escape routes of differing tightness/turn radius under pressure), 6-10 questions, >=4 question types per the schema's own validation rule.
briefs.sourceOfGap: Task B curriculum-matrix.json gapBacklog rank 1; independently re-verified this session against curriculum-ledger.json nodes directly.

briefs.evidenceGapDescription: draft26-u7-vocab-002-q1's original premise ('tap a rink landmark using a position-type interaction') is schema-impossible: src/one-on-one/experimentalBankCore.js requires a position-type question to reference an existing actor (line 48-52) and forces basis!=='coaching' to fail, so it can never express a landmark-only tap. Task C's fix (changing the type to 'choice') is correct and disclosed, but it means the u7-vocab pairing's originally-intended second delivery FORMAT (a different interaction style for the same concept, not just a paraphrase) no longer exists anywhere in the pair.
briefs.recommendedShape: Not authorable as-is. This is a schema/engine capability question first: does a landmark-only-tap interaction belong in the position-type schema at all, or should the U7 pairing's 'second delivery style' goal be met with a different existing type (e.g. sequence)? Needs an engineering/design decision before a replacement question can be drafted.
briefs.sourceOfGap: This session's independent Task C review (draft-revisions.json drafts[u7-vocab-002-q1].lossOfDeliveryVariety field, cross-checked against experimentalBankCore.js lines 48-52).

briefs.recommendedShape: Not new content. Either correct the 5 nodeId strings to a real ledger concept id, or add the missing concept to the ledger if the content genuinely represents a new concept.
